subject: Dedicated pool sizing & timeline for Horizon Q3 expansion
body:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Choe <sarah.choe@horizon-analytics.com>, procure@horizon-analytics.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated pool sizing & timeline for Horizon Q3 expansion

Hi team,

Following our demo with Horizon last week, they signed a heads of terms and are asking for a dedicated capacity proposal that covers US, EU, and APAC pools. They have three immediate production workloads:
- Real-time chat (low-latency, 99th pct target 200ms) — primarily US and EU but growing in APAC.
- Bulk embedding jobs overnight (throughout night windows, heavy batch throughput).
- Reranking for search (spiky, high concurrency).

Key asks from Horizon: guaranteed baseline TPS per region, can burst to higher tiers for marketing events, and a 99.9% uptime SLA for dedicated pools. They requested an implementation timeline (provisioning + onboarding) and a cost estimate for Q3 (90-day commit).

Quick numbers they provided in the RFP (attached):
- US: 25k monthly active users -> expected peak concurrency equivalent to ~160 simultaneous low-latency sessions
- EU: 10k MAU -> ~60 concurrent sessions
- APAC: 5k MAU initially -> ~40 concurrent sessions, double during campaigns

Initial ask: what GPU counts / instance types do we recommend per region (aiming for MHA models like 70B quantized variants and 13B for fallback), and what is our fastest path to get APAC capacity live (partnered vs provisioning Redwood Private).

Action items I propose:
1) Marissa: build a region-by-region pool sizing recommendation with model mapping (70B/13B) and estimated concurrency headroom; include batching assumptions (avg tokens per request, token/sec).
2) Priyom: run cost calc for a 90-day committed pool by region and for burst-enabled scenarios; include expected utilization bands (30/60/90%).
3) Avery: coordinate with Rajiv at CloudPartner on APAC firmware/instance availability and lead times — we may need a marketplace deployment or partner colo to hit their timeline.

I attached the RFP spreadsheet they sent and a quick cost template I started.

Thanks,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

-----Original Message-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, Sarah Choe <sarah.choe@horizon-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jul 2025 10:35:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated pool sizing & timeline for Horizon Q3 expansion

Thanks Karthik — attachment review below and preliminary sizing notes.

Notes:
- Baseline model mix: use 70B quantized for highest-quality responses for chat and reranking; 13B quantized as a cheaper fallback for embeddings and some chat fallthroughs.
- Throughput assumptions: 70B@q4-8 on A100-equivalent -> ~40 tokens/sec per GPU when serving low-latency; effective concurrent sessions per GPU depends heavily on avg token length and our batching window.
- Suggested baseline (conservative):
  * US: 12x A100-80GB equiv (baseline for 160 concurrent low-latency sessions + embedding throughput), with 4x on-call burst capacity (warm warm start via KV cache).
  * EU: 6x A100-80GB equiv baseline, 2x burst.
  * APAC: 4x A100-80GB equiv baseline, 3x burst (APAC demand expected to double during campaigns).
- Embedding / offline: schedule separate low-cost pooled GPU fleet (4x 8-bit T4s) in each region for batch windows to avoid affecting low-latency pools.

I'll turn this into a slide with exact token math (assumptions: avg response 60 tokens, avg request 3 tokens, batching window 50ms) and send by EOD.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Solutions Architect, Dedicated Products
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

-----Original Message-----
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, Sarah Choe <sarah.choe@horizon-analytics.com>, procure@horizon-analytics.com
Date: Wed, 02 Jul 2025 08:44:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated pool sizing & timeline for Horizon Q3 expansion

All — attached is a preliminary 90-day commit cost sheet. Highlights:
- Baseline committed cost (all regions): $1.28M for 90 days (with A100-equivalent instances across US/EU/APAC as Marissa recommended).
- Burst pool (on-demand / reserved prewarming): add ~22% to peak-month costs if they use burst frequently.
- APAC markup: ~12% due to limited vendor availability and expedited provisioning costs.

Procurement note to Horizon (cc): we can accept a region-split PO, but the earliest APAC pool will require either:
  a) CloudPartner marketplace deployment (estimated 3 weeks from order if hardware in-region), or
  b) Redwood Private staging at customer colo (4–6 weeks) — longer but gives Horizon full network control.

I recommend offering a hybrid: immediate US/EU Dedicated pools on Redwood Reserved, and an APAC partner-provisioned pool to hit their Q3 launch. If Horizon wants Private for APAC, we'll need an SOW and longer lead time.

Priyom

--
Priyom Das

Subject: Re: Dedicated pool sizing & timeline for Horizon Q3 expansion

Hi Avery and team,

We can support a 3-week turn-up for an APAC pool if Horizon approves the standard marketplace order today. We have capacity in SYD and SIN regions (A100 and A100-equivalents). Two items:
1) We need confirmation on the exact instance class (A100-80GB vs A100-40GB) — A100-80GB preferred for 70B models.
2) If they require Private (customer-managed network), lead time is 4–6 weeks and we'll need a signed SOW and network diagrams.

We'll prepare a provisional quote and a plug-and-play deployment playbook for Redwood to hand off to Horizon.

Regards,
Rajiv
CloudPartner Ltd.
rajiv@cloudpartner.com
